verdict.rationale: PostHog documents a dedicated MCP server allowing agents to run HogQL/SQL queries, trends, funnels, and retention insights directly from AI editors/Claude, plus an OpenAPI-backed REST API for programmatic access, and a data warehouse that unifies product + external data for one SQL query. This directly matches the story of an agent answering growth questions via API or MCP querying live product data. Missing for 10: independent hands-on verification of MCP query accuracy/performance beyond vendor docs.
